name: egm-install-verify
description: Verify an EGM (Elephant-Goldfish Model) installation receipt: does the document prove all files exist, paths resolve, doctrine mandates the flow, and three harnesses are wired? ADVISORY AND UNCALIBRATED.

all_files_present.instructions: Every named installed file, upstream skill (7), and persona (9) appears in the receipt with a sha256 hash proving it was read and exists on disk

paths_correct.instructions: The skill paths use hyphenated names (egm-brainstorm not egm_brainstorm) matching the actual repository directory structure

doctrine_mandates.instructions: The doctrine excerpt explicitly says EGM is the default or mandatory coding flow for non-trivial work, not merely an optional gate

three_harnesses.instructions: All three harness installations (Aside user skill, OMP command, Prime Agent skill) are listed with their absolute paths and confirmed present

single_source.instructions: All three harnesses reference the same canonical plugin root, not separate copies that could drift

rules.reason: critical files missing from the receipt
doctrine does not mandate EGM as the coding spine
path naming may be stale (underscores vs hyphens)
harnesses may reference different plugin roots
